title: Lesson 2 Quiz: Risk, Return, and Time Horizon Explained Simply

questions.text: According to the lesson, which statement best describes how time horizon affects risk tolerance for investing?
options: Longer time horizon means you should avoid all risk.
Short time horizon allows you to take on higher risk for greater returns.
Longer time horizon gives you cushion to handle market volatility, allowing higher-risk investments.
Time horizon has no impact on risk tolerance.
questions.explanation: The narration explains that a longer time horizon gives you room to ride out market ups and downs, providing the cushion needed to handle volatility and thus allowing higher-risk investments for long-term goals.

questions.text: True or false: Higher potential returns almost always come with higher risk.
questions.explanation: The narration states: 'Higher potential returns almost always come with higher risk.'
